title: Job Responds: My Complaint Is Just

questions.question: What would Job's vexation outweigh?
questions.explanation: Job 6:3 (ESV): "For then it would be heavier than the sand of the sea; therefore my words have been rash."

questions.question: What did Job say God's arrows were doing?
questions.explanation: Job 6:4 (ESV): "For the arrows of the Almighty are in me; my spirit drinks their poison..."

questions.question: What did Job request of God?
options: That it would please God to crush me
questions.correctAnswer: That it would please God to crush me
questions.explanation: Job 6:9 (ESV): "that it would please God to crush me, that he would let loose his hand and cut me off!"

questions.question: What comfort did Job claim to have?
options: I have not denied the words of the Holy One
questions.correctAnswer: I have not denied the words of the Holy One
questions.explanation: Job 6:10 (ESV): "This would be my comfort; yes, I would rejoice in pain unsparing, for I have not denied the words of the Holy One."

questions.question: How did Job describe his friends?
questions.explanation: Job 6:15 (ESV): "My brothers are treacherous as a torrent-bed, as torrential streams that pass away,"

questions.question: What happens to the caravans of Tema?
questions.explanation: Job 6:19 (ESV): "The caravans of Tema look, the travelers of Sheba hope."

questions.question: What does he who withholds kindness from a friend forsake?
questions.explanation: Job 6:14 (ESV): "He who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty."

questions.question: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass?
questions.explanation: Job 6:5 (ESV): "Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass, or the ox low over his fodder?"

questions.question: Can that which is tasteless be eaten without salt?
questions.explanation: Job 6:6 (ESV): "Can that which is tasteless be eaten without salt, or is there any taste in the juice of the mallow?"

questions.question: What did Job refuse to touch?
questions.explanation: Job 6:7 (ESV): "My appetite refuses to touch them; they are as food that is loathsome to me."

questions.question: What did Job invite his friends to do?
options: Turn now, my vindication is at stake
questions.correctAnswer: Turn now, my vindication is at stake
questions.explanation: Job 6:29 (ESV): "Turn, I pray, let no wrong be done. Turn now, my vindication is at stake."

questions.question: Is my strength the strength of what?
questions.explanation: Job 6:12 (ESV): "Is my strength the strength of stones, or is my flesh bronze?"

questions.question: What becomes of the paths of their way?
questions.explanation: Job 6:18 (ESV): "The paths of their way turn aside; they go up into the waste and perish."

questions.question: What did Job ask his friends to teach him?
options: Teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand how I have gone astray
questions.correctAnswer: Teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand how I have gone astray
questions.explanation: Job 6:24 (ESV): "Teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand how I have gone astray."

questions.question: How forceful are honest words?
options: But what does reproof from you reprove?
questions.correctAnswer: But what does reproof from you reprove?
questions.explanation: Job 6:25 (ESV): "How forceful are honest words! But what does reproof from you reprove?"

key_verse_text: This would be my comfort; yes, I would rejoice in pain unsparing, for I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
